facts.fact: The NIU project coordinator says the development team is building a platform to verify NIU numbers online, to tell real from false numbers.

systems.owner: Ministere des finances, du budget et du portefeuille public

COG.note: Civil servant NIU enrolment drive is not skills training.
ETAX, SIGFIP are named only as systems being interfaced with the NIU; their use is not stated.
SYDONIA is named only as being interfaced with the NIU; declaration processing is not stated.

facts.fact: The NIU rests on decree 2004-469 of 3 November 2004, ministerial order 5327 of 12 March 2020 for the modernised biometric NIU, and order 25550 of 12 October 2022 making it mandatory for 8 economic transactions and 5 administrative formalities; no law is named.

COG.note: States over 600,000 natural persons in the NIU database but no population figure or share.
NIU is issued from age 6, not at birth.
No statement on who operates, maintains or owns the system.

facts.fact: Order 25550 of 12 October 2022 makes the NIU compulsory for registering with the social security funds, among five administrative formalities, and for paying duties at the customs border.
The NIU project coordinator says interfaces are being built between the NIU and the revenue systems ETAX (taxes), SYDONIA (customs) and SIGFIP (budget), with others requested.

The finance ministry says the modernised biometric NIU launched in August 2020 is issued to residents from age 6, with a database of over 600,000 natural persons, and card production relaunched in September 2025.
The ministry says enrolment in the new NIU takes iris and fingerprint data in person, and the finance minister says the aim is to limit duplicates and fraud.

COG.note: No electronic payment of taxes or fees stated.
ETAX is named only as an interface target; online filing or payment not stated.

facts.fact: The NIU project coordinator says the NIU file is the taxpayer file of the tax directorate (DGID), and the NIU database holds over 28,000 legal persons beside natural persons.
The ministry says the NIU is compulsory for customs duty declarations and payments, and commercial firms request it through the business creation agency ACPCE.
